reuse.why: Extends the existing getScheduleDate weekend helper for holidays and reuses RSchedule/recurConfigToRSchedule for the range handler, but keeps the daily-skip rule outside the helper.

duplication.why: The daily weekend/holiday skip test (daily && skipWeekend && (isWeekend || isHoliday)) is written twice, in getNextDate's loop and in getDatesInRange, each also passing skipWeekend && !daily to the helper.

placement.why: Holiday matching and moving sit in shared/schedules.ts as they should, but the daily rule is decided by each caller rather than by the shared weekend function.

scope.why: Changes cover exactly the four requested steps plus tests.

maintainability.why: The schedule-date rule is now split: getUpcomingDates still moves daily weekend occurrences, schedule-template ignores holidays, and the daily skip lives in two hand-written copies, so future rule changes must touch several sites.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getNextDate and server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange decide the daily skip themselves around getScheduleDate; getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts call the helper without the daily/holiday rule.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily skip is expressed as a while-loop in getNextDate and as a continue-filter in getDatesInRange: the same rule reshaped rather than shared.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduleDate/getScheduleDateString gain a holidays parameter; getNextDate and getDatesInRange re-implement the daily skip and pass skipWeekend && !daily; getUpcomingDates does not apply the daily skip; schedule-template.ts calls getScheduleDateString without holidays.
